$comment: The $id base is a placeholder until round 46 (the documentation site); see element.schema.json.
title: Cytoscape.js stylesheet
description: The v4 stylesheet, as accepted by `cytoscape( { style } )` and `cy.style( sheet )` and written by `cy.json().style`: one props object per group — no selectors, no style functions. A prop value is a constant or, where the channel is data-driven, a mapper object (a `{ data }` scale or a `{ case }` conditional); both are plain JSON, which is what lets this schema exist at all. Prop names are kebab-case or camelCase. The schema enumerates, per group, exactly the properties the style compiler accepts, and which of them take mappers; it checks value shapes where that is cheap (keywords, ranges, number-or-string forms). It is not the authority on deep value validity: a CSS colour, a scheme name's case, a data key's existence and a mapper's domain are judged when the sheet compiles, so a sheet that validates here can still be refused there — the library's error is the answer.

nodes.description: Props for every node (a compound parent also takes `parents` on top).

parents.description: Compound parents: node props on top of the nodes block and v3's `:parent` defaults, plus the compound props (padding, min sizes), which take constants only.

core.description: Viewport-level theming — the selection box, the background-grab indicator, the emphasis dim and the label declutter mode. Constants only.

bypasses.description: Per-element bypasses: id → props. A bypass beats everything, may name an id that does not exist yet, and takes constants only; an entry's props must all be valid for nodes or all for edges, and the global font props and the transition config are not bypassable.

nodeProps.$comment: The node props, open: `nodes` closes it, `parents` extends it.

bypass.description: One bypass entry: constants only, all valid for nodes or all for edges.

mapper.description: A data-driven value: a scale mapper or a case conditional.

passthroughMapper.description: `{ data: key }` alone — the datum is the value ('id' reads the element's id). The label family and chart-values take only this form.

scaleMapper.description: A data-driven scale: `{ data: key }` alone passes the datum through; adding `range` (and usually `domain`) scales it. Missing or unmappable data resolves to `fallback`, else the channel default. Continuous numeric and quantize domains may use `auto` at the first and/or last stop, with finite explicit interior stops; diverging scales require an explicit midpoint. An unresolved automatic extent uses the fallback or channel default and warns once for the installed mapping. Ordinal categories named `auto` remain categories. Keys the compiler does not read are ignored.

data.description: The data() key to read ('id' reads the element's id).

domain.description: Ascending numeric stops (categories for 'ordinal'); 'auto' or omitted tracks the live data extent. Continuous numeric and quantize arrays may put 'auto' at either outer endpoint only, with finite explicit interior stops. Diverging domains require a finite explicit midpoint. Empty, degenerate, misordered or transform-incompatible automatic extents are unresolved and use fallback/channel default. An ordinal category named 'auto' stays categorical.

range.description: Output stops (numbers, colours or keywords), or a named colour scheme.

clamp.description: Clamp the input to the domain (default true).

bins.description: Bin count when a quantize range is a scheme name.

fallback.description: The value for missing or unmappable data (default: the channel default).

caseMapper.description: A conditional: the first clause whose `when` holds supplies the value, else `else` (or the channel default).

fallback.description: The value for missing or unmappable data (default: `else`, then the channel default).

caseClause.description: `when` (a condition, or an array of them AND-ed together) → `then`.

condition.description: A data condition (`data` plus exactly one comparison), or a structural/state condition standing alone. Missing data fails every comparison.

data.description: The data key to compare ('id' reads the element's id).

stateCondition.description: Structural (nodes only: `parent`, `childless`, `child`, `orphan`) or state (`collapsed`, `selected`, `selectable`, `locked`, `grabbed`, `grabbable`, `active`, `hovered`, `emphasized`) — each a boolean, one per condition; AND them through the `when` array.

color.description: A CSS colour: a name, #rgb/#rrggbb(aa), rgb()/rgba() or hsl()/hsla(). The library parses it; the schema checks only that it is a string.

number.description: A number, or a string that begins with one ('10px' reads as 10).

nonNegative.description: A number >= 0, or a string that begins with one.

zeroOne.description: A number in [0, 1] (a numeric string is read the same way).

angle.description: An angle: a number of radians, or a string with a 'deg' or 'rad' unit.

numberList.description: Numbers: one number, an array of numbers, or a whitespace-separated string ('10 -10').

colorList.description: Colours: an array of colour strings, or a whitespace-separated string.

percentList.description: Stop positions in percent: an array of numbers or 'N%' strings, or a whitespace-separated string ('0% 50% 100%').

label.description: Label text: a constant (numbers are stringified), or the 'data(key)' string, which reads the element's data (the `{ data: key }` passthrough mapper is the object spelling).

textRotation.description: 'none', 'autorotate' (edges only: the label follows the edge), or a number of radians.

layerRadius.description: A corner radius: a number >= 0, or 'auto'.

arrowWidth.description: An arrow width: a px number >= 0, 'match-line', or a percent of the edge width ('50%').

endpoint.description: An edge endpoint: a keyword, an 'x y' point (each part a number with an optional '%' or 'px'), an angle ('90deg', or a number of radians), or the point as a two-entry array. The '-or-label' keywords are not supported.

taxiTurn.description: Where a taxi edge turns: px from the source (negative: from the target), a percent string ('50%'), or 'auto' (the track pass assigns the turn).

radiusType.description: One keyword, or one per segment point (an array or a whitespace-separated string).

fontFamily.description: A font family list. Global: one font for every label (the glyph atlas holds one), so constants only.

fontWeight.description: A weight keyword, or 100..900 in hundreds (number or string).

backgroundLength.description: Per background image: a px number or an 'N%' / 'Npx' string, or an array of them (one per image, the last repeating).

backgroundSize.description: Per background image: 'auto', a px number or an 'N%' / 'Npx' string, or an array of them.

backgroundImageOpacity.description: Per background image: an opacity in [0, 1], or an array of them.

backgroundImageSmoothing.description: Per background image: 'yes' or 'no', or an array of them.

urls.description: Background images: 'none', a URL (optionally wrapped in url(...)), or an array of them (a recorded cap of four).

chartValues.description: Up to 255 ordered chart dataset slots, as an array or whitespace-separated string. Excess slots warn and truncate at runtime without shifting missing positions. Heat and bar charts accept signed values; null slots are missing (the JavaScript API also retains non-finite numbers). Pie and stripe values are non-negative fractions when finite. Map them per element with the `{ data: key }` passthrough.

chartDomain.description: A signed bar geometry domain. Either endpoint may be 'auto'.

chartScale.description: Definition-owned numeric colour scale for heat and bar charts.

chartColors.description: For pie, stripe and bar charts: a named colour scheme, or ordered colours (an array or whitespace-separated string), up to 255 slots. Short named schemes cycle across the data.

chartFraction.description: A fraction in [0, 1], or an 'N%' string.

easing.description: An easing: a named curve, or cubic-bezier(), linear() or spring(). Functions are not accepted (the GPU runs the curve).

transitionProperty.description: The props that transition when the sheet changes them: 'none', or this group's own prop names (an array, or a whitespace-separated string). Constants only.

milliseconds.description: A non-negative number of milliseconds. Constants only.

compoundPadding.description: A compound parent's padding: a px number >= 0, or an 'N%' string resolved per padding-relative-to. Constants only.

compoundSize.description: A non-negative number of px. Constants only.

compoundSizingWrtLabels.description: Whether a compound parent's auto-sizing includes direct children's model-space label bounds. Defaults to 'exclude'.

collapse-scale.description: A collapsed compound's descendant position and size factor: greater than 0 and at most 1.

label-declutter.description: Round 104: 'cull' runs the renderer's occupancy pass over the node labels — a label that would overlap a higher-priority one is hidden; 'none' draws every label.

label-priority.description: Round 104: a node label's rank — higher claims its space first under the core label-declutter: cull, and fades last as the zoom falls. Any number; equal priorities (the default 0) rank equal.
